numb i guess. or maybe not even that. like i keep waiting for the relief to hit and it just. doesnt. ive been in debt since i was 19. thats almost 8 years

braced. yeah. like my whole body is still ready for the next bill or the next emergency that puts me back under. ive never once not been in debt as an adult. i dont know how to just. exist without that weight. what would i even do with that headspace

relief maybe. but the kind thats almost scary because i dont trust it yet. like if i let myself feel it the floor drops out again. but it was there. that loose feeling in my shoulders. i could breathe all the way down for once

still unbelievable. but i want to let it be real. i think i came in here saying i was numb because feeling the good thing is harder than i expected. like i earned the right to relax and i dont know how. 8 years of bracing doesnt just switch off

protecting itself yeah. that lands. its not numb its just careful. maybe the relief gets to be real slowly. i dont have to feel it all at once. just that one breath in the car was enough proof for now
